```{r Load Needed Libraries, include=FALSE}
packages <- c( 
  'marginaleffects',
  'MetBrewer', 
  'brms',
  'rstanarm',
  'ggpubr',
  'data.table', 
  'tidyverse',
  'scales'
)
install_if_missing <- function(package) {
  if (!require(package, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(package, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(package, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

sapply(packages, install_if_missing)
rm(packages, install_if_missing)

#Use Dplyr select as default
select <- dplyr::select

```

```{r Load and Prepare Needed Data}
df_agg <- read.csv(paste0(project_location, '/global_aggregate_expected_paralytics.csv')) |> #csv with data from each hospital generated from 02 script: hospital_id, prone_48, n_patients, observed_paralytic, paralytic_rate_observed, paralytic_rate_adjust, expected_paralytic, not_paralytic
  
  #Prepare to merge in Hospital Details
  mutate(
    hospital_id=fifelse(
        hospital_id=='RUMC', 'Rush', hospital_id)
    ) 

clif_hospital_description <- read.csv(paste0(project_location, '/hospital_information_ma.csv')) |>
    rename(Hospital_Type=hosp_type)

#Merge Hospital Data Into DF AGG
df_agg <- df_agg |>
  left_join(clif_hospital_description %>% select(hospital_id, Hospital_Type))

```

```{r Merge in the Proning Log Odds for Proned and Unproned Patients at Each Hospital}
#Create Row For Each paralytic Summary Data and unparalyzed Summary Data
df_agg_unparalyzed <- df_agg
df_agg_paralyzed <- df_agg_unparalyzed %>%
  mutate(n_patients = observed_paralytic, any_paralytic_48 = 1)
df_agg_unparalyzed <- df_agg_unparalyzed |>
  mutate(n_patients = not_paralytic, observed_paralytic = 0, any_paralytic_48 = 0)
df_agg <- bind_rows(df_agg_paralyzed, df_agg_unparalyzed)

#Merge in Paralytic Adjusted Rate for Each Hospital By paralyzed/Unparalyzed Status
global_agg_byoutcome_prone <- read.csv(paste0(project_location, '/global_aggregate_paralytic_risk_by_outcome_prone.csv')) |>
  mutate(paralytic_log_odds = log(paralytic_rate_adjust / (1 - paralytic_rate_adjust))) |>
  select(hospital_id, any_paralytic_48, paralytic_log_odds, prone_48) |>
  #Prepare to merge in Hospital Details
  mutate(
    hospital_id=fifelse(
        hospital_id=='RUMC', 'Rush', hospital_id)
    ) 

#Merge Back with DF Agg
df_agg <- left_join(df_agg, global_agg_byoutcome_prone) |>
  #IF there were no patients paralyzed can use the propensity for unparalyzed patients by filling here
  group_by(hospital_id, prone_48) |>
  arrange(hospital_id, prone_48, any_paralytic_48) |>
  fill(paralytic_log_odds, .direction = 'down') |>
  ungroup()
```

```{r Now Bayesian Hierarchical Model Including Proning Status}
#Bayesian Hierarchial Model with Random Effects for Hospital and Proning 
set.seed(3)

df_agg$prone_48 <- factor(
  df_agg$prone_48,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = c("Unproned", "Proned")
)

priors <- c(
  #Unproned Paralytics Prior: Weakly Informative Centered Around Prob of Paralytics of 12% among unproned patients with 95% of prior probability in  5-50% range
  prior(normal(-2, 1), class = "b", coef = 'prone_48Unproned'),  
  #Proned Paralytics Prior: Weakly Informative Centered Around Prob of Paralytics of 50% among proned patients and with 95% of these probability ranging from 12-88%
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b", coef = 'prone_48Proned'),
  #Half Normal Weakly Informative but Regularizing Prior for Random Effects
  prior(normal(0,1), class = "sd"))         

#Bayesian Hierarchical Model with varying slopes by study_period and allowing for interaction term between hospital type and period
agg_brm_paralytic_full <- brm(
  bf(observed_paralytic | trials(n_patients) ~ 
       0 + offset(paralytic_log_odds) + prone_48 + (0 + prone_48 | hospital_id)), 
  data = df_agg,
  family = binomial,
  prior = priors, 
  cores = 4,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99)
)

# Examine model fit and summaries
plot(agg_brm_paralytic_full)
summary(agg_brm_paralytic_full)

#Now Generate Odds Ratios for Community vs Academic Proning by Period
full_posterior <- as_draws_df(agg_brm_paralytic_full)

mor_constant <- sqrt(2) * qnorm(0.75)  # approximately 0.954

full_posterior <- full_posterior |>
  mutate(
    mor_unproned = exp(mor_constant * sd_hospital_id__prone_48Unproned),
    mor_proned = exp(mor_constant * sd_hospital_id__prone_48Proned)
  )

summary_posterior <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    variable = "Unproned",
    median_or = median(full_posterior$mor_unproned),
    conf.low = quantile(full_posterior$mor_unproned, 0.025),
    conf.high = quantile(full_posterior$mor_unproned, 0.975)
  ),
  tibble(
    variable = "Proned",
    median_or = median(full_posterior$mor_proned),
    conf.low = quantile(full_posterior$mor_proned, 0.025),
    conf.high = quantile(full_posterior$mor_proned, 0.975)
  )
)

print(summary_posterior)
write.csv(summary_posterior, paste0(project_location, '/summary_output/summary_posterior.csv'))
```

```{r Caterpillar Plots Based on Full Adjustment (Including Hospital Type and Size)}
####Predictions Command from Marginal Effects with 4000 posterior draws
set.seed(4)

reliability_adjust_full <- predictions(agg_brm_paralytic_full, 
                                  type = 'response', ndraws=4000, re_formula =  ~ (0 + prone_48 | hospital_id))

reliability_adjust_full <- as_tibble(reliability_adjust_full) |>
  left_join(df_agg %>% 
         select('hospital_id', 'Hospital_Type', 'paralytic_log_odds', 'prone_48', 'any_paralytic_48'), 
         by = c('hospital_id', 'prone_48', 'paralytic_log_odds')) |>
  
  #Need to Recombine paralytic outcome Estimates into 1 Per Hospital and proning status
  group_by(hospital_id, prone_48) |>
  mutate(
    estimate_add=sum(estimate, na.rm=T),
    ci_low_add=sum(conf.low, na.rm=T),
    ci_hi_add=sum(conf.high, na.rm=T),
    n_patients=sum(n_patients, na.rm=T)
  ) |>
  arrange(hospital_id, prone_48, -any_paralytic_48) |> #This Arranges so Row Number 1 is the any_paralytic_48=1
  filter(row_number()==1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(adjust_rate=estimate_add/n_patients) |>
  mutate(ci_low=ci_low_add/n_patients) |>
  mutate(ci_hi=ci_hi_add/n_patients) |>
  #Orders for Graph
  arrange(prone_48, adjust_rate) |>
  mutate(hospital_rank=row_number()) |>
  mutate(actual_rate=observed_paralytic/n_patients) |>
  mutate(grouping='Actual Rate') |>
  left_join(df_agg %>% select('hospital_id', 'Hospital_Type')) |>
  distinct()

break_points <- reliability_adjust_full |>
  mutate(unprone_num=fcase(
    row_number()!=1 & prone_48==0 & lead(prone_48)==1, hospital_rank)
    ) |>
  summarise(
    unprone_num=mean(unprone_num,na.rm=T)+0.5)
```

```{r Stacked Caterpillar Plots}
#Stack Caterpillar Plots Vertically
vertical_data <- reliability_adjust_full |>
  group_by(prone_48) |>
  arrange(prone_48, adjust_rate) |>
  mutate(hospital_rank=row_number()) |>
  ungroup()

stacked_data <- vertical_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    prone_48 = factor(
      trimws(as.character(prone_48)),
      levels = c("Unproned", "Proned")
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(prone_48) |>
  dplyr::arrange(adjust_rate, hospital_id, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    hospital_rank = dplyr::row_number()
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

ajrccm_colors <- c(
  "Unproned" = "#0072B2",  # blue
  "Proned"   = "#D55E00"   # vermilion
)

stacked <- ggplot(
  stacked_data,
  aes(
    x = hospital_rank,
    y = adjust_rate
  )
) +

  # Posterior 95% credible intervals
  geom_linerange(
    aes(
      ymin = ci_low,
      ymax = ci_hi,
      color = prone_48
    ),
    linewidth = 0.65,
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +

  # Adjusted hospital estimates
  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = prone_48,
      shape = Hospital_Type
    ),
    size = 2.5,
    stroke = 0.8
  ) +
scale_color_manual(
  name = "Proning status",
  values = ajrccm_colors,
  breaks = c("Unproned", "Proned"),
  labels = c(
    "Unproned" = "Not proned",
    "Proned"   = "Proned"
  ),
  drop = FALSE
) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = NULL,
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.20),
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +

  # Display 0%–100% without deleting observations from the data
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +

  labs(
  x = "Hospital Rank",
  y = "Eligible Patients Receiving NMBAs Within 48 Hours, %",
  shape = "Hospital type"
) + 

    guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      override.aes = list(alpha = 1, linewidth = 0.8)
    ),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 10,
    base_family = "Arial"
  ) +

  theme(
    # Axes
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      margin = margin(t = 8)
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 8)
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 9,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),

    # Legend
  legend.position = "inside",
  legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.98),
  legend.justification = c(0, 1),
  legend.direction = "horizontal",
  legend.box = "vertical",
  legend.box.just = "left",
  legend.background = element_rect(
  fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.90),
  color = NA
),
  legend.margin = margin(4, 6, 4, 6),
  legend.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "cm"),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 9),

   

    # Caption
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 8,
      color = "black",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(t = 8)
    ),

    plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)
  ) + 

  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "sans")
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "stacked_caterpillar.pdf",
  path = paste0(project_location, "/summary_output/graphs/"),
  plot = stacked,
  width = 12,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",

)
```
